items.headline: Albemarle Has Lost 52% Since April: BMO Sees 70% Upside
items.snippet: Q2 net sales +31% to $1.7B, adj. EBITDA $858M. Q3 Energy Storage sales/EBITDA expected to decrease sequentially on lower volumes and pricing. 2026 Energy Storage volumes 225-235kt after Talison CGP3 fire.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Price targets cut across RBC, BofA, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Mizuho, UBS and Argus on softer lithium sentiment and spot weakness. Truist, Scotiabank, Argus cite cost discipline and resilient lithium demand.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium price up ~67% YoY but well below all-time highs; Argus sees supply/demand improving into 2027; balance sheet solid.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered Albemarle PT to $175 from $200, Outperform, on recent lithium spot price weakness; group viewed as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market from EV and stationary storage demand with supply lagging; maintained 2026 outlook at high end of scenario ranges; $100M run-rate savings YTD.
